value.rationale: The first rigorous ordinary von Neumann counterexample is certificate-based at one exact Werner parameter. A concrete two-sided interval with a uniform positive gap establishes that the phenomenon is robust under parameter perturbation rather than merely certifiable at an isolated point. The radius is motivated by stability of the newly proved phenomenon, not by an arbitrary parameter slice; maximality is not claimed.
